sq.q: Why is understanding the human being considered the first step in this course?
answer: Because a human being is the central participant in existence, and right understanding of the self forms the foundation for harmony in family, society, and nature.

sq.q: What are the three key roles of the human being?
answer: A human being functions as the knower (who understands) , experiencer (who feels emotions and aspirations) , and doer (who performs actions based on understanding and feelings) .

lq.q: Explain why family is considered the basic unit of human interaction.
answer: Family is the basic unit of human organisation because it is the first place where a human being learns to live in relationship. The main issue in family is not only physical facility, but the fulfilment of relationship. To live in relationship, we must understand relationship correctly. Relationship exists between one Self and another Self; the body is only used as an instrument to express feelings. Feelings such as trust, respect, affection, care, guidance, reverence, glory, gratitude and love are definite in relationship. When these feelings are understood, recognised and fulfilled, the result is mutual happiness. If relationship is not understood, even people living together may remain in opposition, irritation or conflict. Therefore, harmony in the family begins with understanding the Self, understanding feelings in relationship, and living with the intention of fulfilling relationship.
